mapper.select: WITH with_cg AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t1.fund_cd , t1.jm_cd , t1.aek , t1.jan_aek , t1.sanghw_ymd , t2.sanghw_aek , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.corp_gr,t1.tr_ymd,t1.tr_cd,t1.fund_cd,t1.jm_cd,t1.seq_no) AS cnt FROM SCT1CG t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN sct1cg_tr t2 ON t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.tr_ymd = t1.tr_ymd AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND t2.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND t2.tr_cd = t1.tr_cd AND t2.buy_date = t1.buy_date AND t2.aek_gb = t1.aek_gb AND t2.seq_no = t1.seq_no AND t2.sanghw_aek > 0 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.tr_ymd = #{trYmd} AND t1.tr_cd = #{trCd} AND t1.gwamok = '12049' AND t1.aek_gb = '3' ) SELECT cg.corp_gr AS corpGr , cg.tr_ymd AS trYmd , cg.tr_cd AS trCd , cg.fund_cd AS fundCd , cg.jm_cd AS jmCd , cg.buy_date AS buyDate , cg.seq_no AS seqNo , cg.tr_co_cd AS trCoCd , cg.ija_baed_gb AS ijaBaedGb , cg.koscom_cd AS koscomCd , cg.jusic_jusu AS jusicJusu , cg.jusic_aek AS jusicAek , cg.jusic_danga AS jusicDanga , cg.danc_gb AS dancGb , cg.mijigub_tax AS mijigubTax , ia.fund_nm AS xxFundCd , cg.aekm AS aekm , cg.danga AS danga , (NVL(cm.bfil_aekm,0) + NVL(cm.meib_aekm,0) - NVL(cm.medo_aekm,0)) / 10000 AS com_aekm , cg.chg_jm_cd AS chgJmCd , cg.lock_end AS lockEnd , CASE WHEN t1.sanghw_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS suryChk , t1.sanghw_ymd AS suryYmd , t1.aek AS aek , CASE WHEN t1.sanghw_ymd < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'dd') THEN 1 WHEN t1.cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS suryProtect , 1 AS pVisible FROM SCT0CG cg LEFT OUTER JOIN with_cg t1 ON t1.fund_cd = cg.fund_cd AND t1.jm_cd = cg.jm_cd , SZM0IA ia , SCM0CM cm WHERE cg.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND cg.tr_ymd = #{trYmd} AND cg.jm_cd LIKE #{cjCd} AND cg.tr_cd = #{trCd} AND ia.corp_gr = cg.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = cg.fund_cd AND cm.corp_gr = cg.corp_gr AND cm.ymd = cg.tr_ymd AND cm.fund_cd = cg.fund_cd AND cm.jm_cd = cg.jm_cd

WITH with_cg AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t1.fund_cd , t1.jm_cd , t1.aek , t1.jan_aek , t1.sanghw_ymd , t1.tr_co_cd , t2.sanghw_aek , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.corp_gr,t1.tr_ymd,t1.tr_cd,t1.fund_cd,t1.jm_cd,t1.seq_no) AS cnt FROM SCT1CG t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN sct1cg_tr t2 ON t2.corp_gr=t1.corp_gr AND t2.tr_ymd=t1.tr_ymd AND t2.tr_cd=t1.tr_cd AND t2.fund_cd=t1.fund_cd AND t2.jm_cd=t1.jm_cd AND t2.buy_date=t1.buy_date AND t2.aek_gb=t1.aek_gb AND t2.seq_no=t1.seq_no AND t2.sanghw_aek > 0 WHERE t1.corp_gr=#{corpGr} AND t1.gwamok='12049' AND t1.aek_gb='3' AND t1.tr_ymd=#{trYmd} ) SELECT t2.fund_cd AS fundCd , t2.fund_nm AS xxFundCd , t2.mg_cd AS trCoCd , (NVL(t1.bfil_aekm,0)+NVL(t1.meib_aekm,0)-NVL(t1.medo_aekm,0))/10000 AS comAekm , NVL(t1.bfil_chui_aek,0)+NVL(t1.meib_aek,0)-NVL(t1.medo_aek,0) AS holdingAek , CASE WHEN t3.sanghw_ymd IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS suryChk , t3.sanghw_ymd AS suryYmd , t3.aek AS aek , CASE WHEN t3.sanghw_ymd < t1.ymd THEN 1 WHEN t3.cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS suryProtect FROM SCM0CM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN with_cg t3 ON t3.fund_cd=t1.fund_cd AND t3.jm_cd=t1.jm_cd, SZM0IA t2 WHERE t1.corp_gr=#{corpGr} AND t1.jm_cd=#{cjCd} AND t1.ymd=#{trYmd} AND t2.corp_gr=t1.corp_gr AND t2.fund_cd=t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t2.fund_cd
